messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate observed for Dedicated-EU pool (eu-west-2). Paging samir (oncall) and primary SRE rotation. Incident ID: INC-20260315-EU-DED.

samir (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Starting triage — checking router/queue depth and recent deploys.

mike (sre): I'm hopping in. Not seeing any recent deploys in the last 2 hours. App servers show elevated latencies and some connection resets to the model-serving runtime. Collecting `tcpdump` and `dmesg`.

kayla (prodops): Noted customer-impact flags: HelixBank (tier-enterprise, dedicated) and OrchidHealth (private). Both have active sessions. Setting comms posture: statuspage + targeted emails.

samir (oncall): Quick findings: KV cache misses spike at token 1-3, GPU utilization low on several nodes, stuck processes on node ded-eu-07 causing connection backlog. Possible runaway memory fragmentation.

mike (sre): I can repro a stuck worker with PID 21437 on ded-eu-07. Restarting the process now (safe restart pattern). Will patch svc to drain in-flight requests first.

incident-bot: ACTION: `dedicated-pool:drain node=ded-eu-07` initiated by mike at 1918456902.

mike (sre): Drain completed. Restarting worker and clearing KV cache shards for that node. Observability: error rate trending down from 18% -> 6% in 3m.

samir (oncall): Good. I'm preparing a status page message and customer notifications. Draft below — please review for HelixBank + OrchidHealth tailored lines.

statuspage-bot: Posting preliminary status: "Degraded performance in Dedicated EU cluster affecting a subset of customers. We are mitigating by restarting affected nodes. Further updates within 30 minutes."

kayla (prodops): Draft for enterprise-tailored notification (short):

```
Subject: Redwood Inference — Service degradation affecting Dedicated EU (HelixBank)

Hi <HelixBank Ops lead>,

We detected degraded performance for Dedicated EU customers beginning 2026-03-15 10:18 UTC affecting model inference requests routed to your reserved pool. Symptoms: intermittent 5xx errors and increased tail latency. Impact: some requests may fail or take longer to complete. Our SREs have identified a stuck worker on node ded-eu-07 and performed a safe restart; overall success rate is improving. No customer data was accessed outside of normal request handling. ETA for full recovery: 30-60 minutes; we will update you as we have progress.

Contact: Jess (Account Manager) — jess@redwood.ai; For urgent escalation call +1-555-0142.

Apologies for the disruption,
Redwood Inference Operations
```

kayla (prodops): Also include OrchidHealth-specific note: they run private deployment; we need to confirm whether their edge VPC connectors have retries configured.

jess (acctmgr): I'll ping HelixBank's ops lead and include the message. Suggest adding explicit mitigation steps to share: clearing client-side retries for 60s, fallback to cached embeddings if available.

eric (customer-eng): For OrchidHealth, note: "Impact limited to inference path for non-session-backed requests routed via Dedicated-EU. If you use the private-hosted agent, switch to the secondary region (ap-south-1) as a temporary measure." Also attach runbook link.

olivia (legal): Confirming line "No customer data was accessed outside of normal request handling" — that's fine as long as we don't claim root cause yet. Keep wording conservative.

samir (oncall): Updated consolidated public status update (posting now):

```
We are experiencing degraded performance for a subset of requests in the Dedicated EU pool (eu-west-2). Symptoms include intermittent 5xx responses and increased latency for in-flight requests. We have identified affected worker nodes and are performing targeted restarts; error rates are falling. We will post another update within 30 minutes or sooner if there is material change.
```

statuspage-bot: Posted update (INC-20260315-EU-DED).

nora (support): Support note/template for front-line agents:

"Customers reporting failures on Dedicated EU: Apologize, confirm account and whether using Dedicated or Private. Tell them SREs are mitigating a worker-level issue; provide ETA 30-60m. Escalate to acctmgr (jess) for enterprise customers and open a dedicated support link to the incident thread: <link>."

mike (sre): Monitoring: 5xx rate now 1.8%, latency tail improving. Continuing to watch memory alloc patterns; adding a temporary guard to restart any worker exceeding 75% fragmentation in 5m window.

samir (oncall): Important — customer list and routing we used for outbound notifications (for record):
- HelixBank — primary: helix-ops@helixbank.com, backup: engineering@helixbank.com — Account owner: Jess. Escalation phone +1-555-0199.
- OrchidHealth — primary: support@orchidhealth.com, private deployment contact: engops@orchidhealth.com — Account owner: Eric.
- NovaRetail (tier-smb, shared) — notify via status page only per SLA.

samir (oncall): Internal exec template for COMMs (copy for sales/account execs):

```
Subject: Incident update — Dedicated EU performance degradation (HelixBank / OrchidHealth)

TL;DR: We experienced degraded inference performance in the Dedicated EU pool starting 2026-03-15 10:18 UTC. Root cause: under investigation, likely worker-level memory fragmentation causing connection backlogs. Mitigation: restarted affected nodes and applied automatic restart guard; error rates returning to normal. Impacted: subset of Dedicated-EU customers (HelixBank, OrchidHealth). ETA: 30-60 minutes for full recovery. Next update: in 30 minutes or on major change.

Asked items for sales/AM teams: please hold outbound customer calls until we confirm full recovery. If customers call you directly, use the customer-specific notification copy above and route urgent calls to Jess (acctmgr).

Thanks — Ops
```

jess (acctmgr): Sent HelixBank email at 1918457400 and started a call. Helix confirms mild user-facing errors in their QA environment; they requested standby for 30m.

eric (customer-eng): Sent OrchidHealth note at 1918457505. They are switching some traffic to ap-south-1 as a temporary measure.

samir (oncall): Current status: stabilized but not fully recovered. Leaving incident open for monitoring and RCA. Action items: (1) Mike to run heap profiler on ded-eu-07; (2) ProdOps to prepare rollback/patch if restarts recur; (3) Support to reconcile all outbound notifications.

mike (sre): Will start profiler in 10m and upload flamegraphs to the incident artifact bucket.

kayla (prodops): I'll draft the follow-up status update once we have profiler results.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager duty incident acknowledged by samir at 1918456898.

samir (oncall): Thanks team. Closing on-call handoff in 60 minutes unless escalated. Will post final resolution or major update by 1918457845.

statuspage-bot: Scheduled final update window at 1918457845.

samir (oncall): (final) Error rates remain <2% for 20m. Marking incident "monitoring". RCA to follow.
